06/15/2023
Claimant reported a low-speed head-on collision and a wrist fracture. The driver is named on the policy, and nothing
in the file suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
06/24/2023
The police report and independent witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the time of the collision. The
wrist fracture is consistent with the kind of force a frontal impact at this speed would produce.
08/02/2023
Treatment has continued somewhat longer than is typical for this type of fracture. The medical history check shows
no earlier injury to the same wrist or arm.
08/05/2023
The vehicle inspection shows damage on the opposite side of the front end and at a different height from the impact
the claimant described. No earlier damage to the vehicle appears in our records or the prior claims search.
12/12/2023
A traffic camera near the reported location shows no collision at that place and time. Requested footage and
confirmation of the camera's field of view from the operator.
12/24/2023
In the first call, the claimant described the direction of travel and the number of occupants differently than in the
follow-up statement. Aksed the claimant to clarify both points.
01/22/2024
Referred the file for further review before any settlement discussion. No payment has been authorized; the claim will
be reassessed once the camera footage and inspection finidngs are reconciled with the statements.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
